## Contract review

Head-sha: `63e83cf3d846036631cffcd63443b40c2a1787b9`
Local-runs: none

Face: governed rule text (`references/execution-duties.md`, `references/contract-review.md`) beside the three PM tools that read it. Reviewed in-seat at tier by the dispatching seat, on the full 893-line diff against the merge base `a9fb83ef` and the card; the check conclusions are the head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

- G1 `sisterRepoTierRun`: answers only a slug the governed register knows and is not this repo (`governedSisterRepo` over the injected `GOVERNED_REPOS` / `SELF_REPO_ID`), from `deriveTier(paths)` over the two glob tables, before the banner; refuses at exit 2 with nothing on stdout when no paths are named; every other mode keeps the wrong-repo refusal, now pointing at the tier route. The provenance goes to stderr, stdout stays paste-clean. Correct; the policy applied to objectui's `skills/objectui/**` (MANDATORY under the published-catalog glob) is the 2026-09-10 ruling as written, not a new mandate.
- G2 `readContainerModelLine` / `containerModelRefusal`: the key at line start with the record readers' decoration tolerance; the declared tier is the first token after `model:`; a ceiling spelling (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, its value, or the ladder word while the ceiling is its own tier) owes `MANDATORY` or `reason:` on the same line; absence of the line or of a token refuses nothing; the refusal names the ceiling by the constant's name and quotes no model id. `post-stamped.mjs` imports it as the fourth claim reader on `--comment` only and lists it in the refusal text. Measured against this seat's own claims of the day: the three `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER … MANDATORY …` lines and the one `TIER_DEFAULT` line all pass. Correct.
- G3: `execution-duties.md` :107 folds the two downgrade-exit lines into one with the same rule (the quota exemption falls to the default tier only when the at-tier model is measured unavailable, never lower; the pre-emptive downgrade) and :108 states the other half — a quota wall moves down only, never up; a temporary deviation is written on the seat post with an end condition and re-read each check-in. 183 / 183, both lines 118 bytes. Correct, nothing operative lost.
- G4: `readLocalRuns` reads a line-initial `Local-runs:` anywhere in the record, `none` or `probe` + separator + non-empty reason; `localRunsStand` stands on `missing` and `read`, refuses only `unreadable`; the template prints `Local-runs: none`; `post-stamped` refuses an unreadable line before the write, scoped by the record heading marker; the merge-queue guard is untouched and the three landed PASS records on PR 20254 / 20256 / 20257 carry no line and stand (pinned by the legacy fixture). `--brief-template` carries the read-only lines, the adversarial input set, the record template by name, no angle bracket, no model id. Correct.
- `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER_NAME` now declared beside the constant and re-exported: one spelling for the claim reader and the record reader. Correct.
- No accept set and no public surface changes; nothing published; self-tests: dispatch-gates +32 cases (count floor only, as that file declares no battery roster), post-stamped 610 → 629 across 22 batteries (roster floor 17), record-recognisers 110 → 136 across 8 batteries (roster floor 8). Nit, not a defect: one dispatch-gates self-test fixture spells the default tier's ladder word as a literal where `TIER_DEFAULT` would do.

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, in no package's `files[]` ⇒ no changeset; `skip-changeset` correct; consistent with `Clause-②: no`.

### ③ Boundary flags

The one `open_questions` entry (should `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` also read `Local-runs:`) is answered **A** by the seat: the write-time refusal in `post-stamped` is the door, records reach the board only through it, and a second reader of one line is the drift this family refuses; B only if a record ever lands through a channel `post-stamped` does not front. Deviations accepted: the false mechanism assumption on dispatch-gates' self-test shape; objectui's catalog being a mandated surface by the glob policy; the census line pin moved by the header usage line; the +4 (not +2) lines in `contract-review.md` under the 120-byte wrap; `SKILL.md` untouched because the template's slot already says to quote the `--tier` output. The PR body quotes the incident spelling (the ladder word) as the refused shape; it is not an id form. No flag remains open.
